programs.description: Inside Kleinfeld Bridal, the Manhattan-based bridal salon that is arguably the world's finest, more than 250 professionals, most of them veterans from the shop's early days in Brooklyn, bend over backward to make each bride's experience unforgettable. Part bridal story, part fashion makeover and part family therapy session, each episode looks at the personalities and craftsmanship that come into play as the Kleinfeld staff go to sometimes extreme lengths to realize each bride's dreams.
Pairs of professional bakers create spellbinding edible showpieces on the sets where Harry Potter's magical journey was filmed in England.

Twelve elite chefs are stranded on a remote island, where survival is as vital as cooking; to earn Chopped baskets, they must conquer physical trials, build their own kitchens, and master open-fire culinary arts in a gruelling weekly battle.

Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the first round of this cooking competition show. The winner of this round then goes up against Bobby Flay, with Flay making his own version of the competitor's signature dish.

Drew and Jonathan Scott team up with American A-listers to renovate properties. Then, the celebrities give the refurbished homes to people who have supported them.

After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.
Chef Robert Irvine tries to help failing restaurants make a comeback. Armed with two days and a budget of $10,000, he updates their menus and their fortunes to help them become successful again.
